Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 5

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting chronological data. Despite accurately retrieving the birthdates of Aryeh Ben-Eliezer (born December 16, 1913) and Jason Pociask (born February 9, 1983), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Jason Pociask was older, which contradicts the basic temporal logic that someone born in 1913 is older than someone born in 1983. This error stems from misapplication of comparative logic, failing to correctly analyze the order of numerical data when forming the final conclusion.
